svg.title: An inverse function has the reciprocal slope at the reflected point
svg.desc: The graph of f(x) = x cubed + x (crimson) and of its inverse g (blue), mirror images in the dashed line y = x. The point (1, 2) on f, where the tangent line has slope 4, reflects to the point (2, 1) on g, where the tangent line has slope 1/4. So g prime of 2 equals 1 over f prime of 1.
